description: This file contains platform-specific functions for device image checking, upgrading, and configuration copying as part of the OpenWrt/LEDE firmware build system. It includes functions to determine device model and perform appropriate upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the provided image is compatible with the device based on its board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedure depending on the device model identified by the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration during upgrade, based on the board name.
